articles.summary: GRAND CAYMAN, Cayman Islands, May 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Patria Investments Limited (Nasdaq:PAX) announced today that it will release financial results for the first quarter 2026 on Thursday, May 7, 2026, and host a conference call via public webcast at 9:00 a.m. ET.
articles.title: Patria Announces First Quarter 2026 Investor Call

articles.summary: GRAND CAYMAN, Cayman Islands, May 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Patria Investments Limited (Nasdaq:PAX) reported today its unaudited results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The full detailed presentation of Patria's first quarter 2026 results can be accessed on the Shareholders section
